caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pair of metal tongs, rendered in grayscale on a plain, light beige background. The tongs are shown in a side profile, with decorative cutout patterns along both arms. Each arm has an ornate design that includes oval and diamond-shaped holes, with an engraved or embossed section near the tips and at the base. The tips of the tongs widen into shell-like or floral shapes. There is a shadowed effect to give the object a three-dimensional appearance. In the bottom left corner, there is a small, stylized signature or label reading "WALTON, K."
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
